jobs.description: Warum roadsurfer? TEAMSPIRIT & TEAM-EVENTS: Flache Hierarchien, viel Spaß, ein starker Teamspirit und regelmäßige Events wie gemeinsame Sport-Sessions oder Pizza- & Bier-Abende. PERSÖNLICHE ENTWICKLUNG: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem individuellen Growth Plan und unserer Inhouse Academy. CAMPER-BUDGET: Ein jährliches Camper-Budget, damit du den #happyroadsurfing-Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst. Halte 4.000+ Camper auf der Straße Als Head of Fleet Operations DACH sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Camper startklar sind, wenn unsere Gäste losfahren wollen. Du führst unsere 2 Senior Fleet Technicians, 5 Regional Fleet Manager und damit indirekt die Fleet Manager, Techniker:innen und Schadensexpert:innen an über 40 Stationen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Business Director DACH und bist Teil des DACH-Leadership-Teams. Was dich erwartet: ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen, ein junges, motiviertes Team und viel, das noch aufgebaut werden will. Nicht jeder Prozess existiert schon – viele davon gestaltest du selbst. Wenn du für deine Arbeit fertige Strukturen brauchst, ist das wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, Reparaturdauer, Kosten und Qualität im DACH-Markt. Du verantwortest das Budget für Wartung, Reparatur und Fahrzeugtransfers. Du baust unser Netz aus internen und externen Werkstätten und Servicepartnern auf und steuerst es. Du legst Reparaturstrategien fest und sorgst dafür, dass Ersatzteile und Werkstattkapazitäten fließen. Du führst und entwickelst deine Regional Fleet Manager und hebst das Level der Teams an unseren Stationen. Du steuerst über KPIs (Reparaturkosten, Durchlaufzeit, Verfügbarkeit, Schadenserkennung) und treibst Verbesserungen voran. Du arbeitest eng mit den Regional Operations Managern zusammen, die die P&L der Stationen verantworten. Wo du herkommen könntest Du musst nicht aus der Camper- oder Autovermietung kommen. You won’t need to personally execute every configuration, migration, or integration; your role is to ensure those pieces come together into a successful customer outcome. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. You will ensure that the right projects move forward at the right pace, with the right people and resources. Beyond coordinating the overall portfolio, you will also take direct ownership of selected strategic projects, such as greenfield office buildouts (FDOBs) and M&A integrations. You will help bring structure, visibility, and consistency to our IT project delivery while remaining close enough to the technical work to make things happen. If you enjoy driving complex technical projects, coordinating diverse teams, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing environment, this role offers the opportunity to have a direct impact on how Mistral scales its IT operations globally. jobs.description: About us INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries. Our work spans five complementary activities: INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date). INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date). INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year). INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management). INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more). About the program: AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition. About the role: We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.
